standing: Interim root assessment of read source and selected p03 results. No final design verdict.
qualifications: p03 schema/consumer equality is intentionally not required for registry-dependent plane/kind membership: 28 native cross-plane,18imported cross-plane,4imported cross-kind cases are consumer-only refusals; exact owning annotations select this boundary. Initial docstring blanket equality claim is not supported and should not be repeated.

p03 vocabulary aggregates mistakenly include perKindApplicability.rule prose as a relation/list; three false aggregates are probe extraction errors. Individual two imported kinds are handled explicitly and all191 expected consumer outcomes agree.

p03 four producer helper inputs are partial convenience dictionaries, not owning complete native objects or retained Runs. For example ClosedWorldV2 and ResolutionCompletenessV2 required fields are omitted. These do not prove native admission or authorization.

p03 ROUNDTRIP records carry pc.target label into references for all4, rather than forwarding actual produced object and original relation. All4 actual results independently do produce that exact sole deficiency, so token carryability is corroborated; derivation-policy types-to-references is not original-relation roundtrip.

p02 prose-stripped flattened-leaf diff is a heuristic over six selected documents, not a proof all normative law or container structure is unchanged: empty containers, escaped-pointer correctness and normative text keys require actual source review.
derive_counts first pass is exploratory extraction, not a complete correctly keyed comparison of all declared headline values; inspect subsequent actual manual/corrected measurements.
reportReadScope: Summary, all four producer results, all10presence controls, all4roundtrip controls and schema-difference category aggregation read; other per-case records not yet individually read.
